parts:
Hi all!

I am trying to build a mixture model of common and spatially varying coefficient.

Its structure as follows:

X is the covariate and f(X) is a CAR model with spatially varying coefficient.

zi is the mixing parameter that follows a Bernoulli prior.

This model could been implemented by OpenBUGS, but I have no idea how to describe this model structure with a formula in INLA.

 

Best regards,
